query:
-- Disable Oracle VM sync
UPDATE admin_config SET oracleSyncEnabled = 0, updatedAt = NOW();

-- Check current state
SELECT id, oracleSyncEnabled, lastOracleSyncAt, lastSyncInserted FROM admin_config;

-- Row counts
SELECT 'htlc_swaps' as tbl, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM htlc_swaps
UNION ALL SELECT 'swap_analytics', COUNT(*) FROM swap_analytics
UNION ALL SELECT 'peer_reputation', COUNT(*) FROM peer_reputation
UNION ALL SELECT 'peer_messages', COUNT(*) FROM peer_messages
UNION ALL SELECT 'peer_blocks', COUNT(*) FROM peer_blocks
UNION ALL SELECT 'peer_reports', COUNT(*) FROM peer_reports
UNION ALL SELECT 'peer_mutes', COUNT(*) FROM peer_mutes
UNION ALL SELECT 'admin_audit_log', COUNT(*) FROM admin_audit_log;
